verdict.rationale:
Meilisearch's self-hosting model (single binary, no external dependencies, runnable anywhere) gives users full control over data location by choosing their own hosting infrastructure/region, and this is documented and probe-verified as fast/easy. However, there is no first-party documentation of explicit region/residency selection for Meilisearch Cloud; a community comment notes Cloud's only regions are limited (closest to Australia being Singapore), suggesting constrained cloud region choice rather than a documented residency feature.

missing for 10: explicit Cloud region-selection settings/docs, formal data-residency/compliance statements (e.g. GDPR region guarantees), independent confirmation of self-hosted deployments satisfying residency requirements.
